title: Cult of Calia pt. 4: Ascension
description:
Your journey has reached it's apex, my apprentice. It is time to reach the highest rank in my cult. To do so, you will be brought to a private place in the cult compound, where the true secrets of my cult will be revealed.

Nothing you know, nothing you have experienced will prepare you for what is to come, but steel yourself, for you must know the truth, and the truth will cement your place with me, forever. You will become my advocate, regardless of what you hear, no matter how strange, how frightening, or how bizarre.

It is time, apprentice. Ascend.

CW: This is part of a series that uses the 'cult' theme. I want to make it clear that I do not endorse cults in any way. This is not a series about creating a real life 'cult of Calia', rather it is a dark fantasy/mystery series with some creepy vibes, and is not meant to be taken seriously. As such, there are no attached tasks, or mass interaction.
author: Mistress Calia
